<!--
Notebook for performing comparisons of coding mutations between colibactin positive and
colibactin negative crypts. dnds_mut_annotation.tsv is derived from running dNdScv package
for annotation of 
mutations
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  comment    = "#>",
  fig.width  = 7,
  fig.height = 4,
  dpi        = 300
)
 
set.seed(42)
```
 
## Dependencies
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
dnds_mut_annotation<-read.delim('../Data/dnds_mut_annotation.tsv')
```

```{r}
## combine crypt annotation of colibactin positive with dNdS outputs :
coding_mutations_df <- left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient')) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient,biopsy,sample, biopsy_colibactin_pos,crypt_colibactin_pos,age,location,site,cohort,
         missense, nonsense, synonymous, indel,essential_Splice,stop_loss)

coding_mutations_long<-coding_mutations_df%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('nonsense', 'missense','indel','synonymous'),names_to='Effect',values_to = 'muts')
```

## b : test associations for mutations
```{r}

fit_effect_model <- function(effect) {
  summary(lmer(muts ~ crypt_colibactin_pos + age + (1 | patient) + (1 | location), data = coding_mutations_long[coding_mutations_long$Effect == effect,]))}

ml_results <- list(
  indel      = fit_effect_model("indel"),
  missense   = fit_effect_model("missense"),
  nonsense   = fit_effect_model("nonsense"),
  synonymous = fit_effect_model("synonymous")
)

## extract p values from regression :
extract_colibactin_p <- function(model_summary) {
  coef_tab <- model_summary$coefficients
  p <- coef_tab["crypt_colibactin_posTRUE", "Pr(>|t|)"]
}

coding_p_df <- tibble(
  Effect = names(ml_results),
  pvalue = purrr::map_dbl(ml_results, extract_colibactin_p))%>%
  mutate(Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c("missense", "nonsense", "indel", "synonymous")))

## adjust pvalues using Benhamini Hochberg :
coding_p_df$pvalue_adj=p.adjust(coding_p_df$pvalue,method='BH')
coding_p_df$label=case_when(coding_p_df$pvalue_adj<0.001 ~'P < 0.001',
                            TRUE~paste0('P = ',round(coding_p_df$pvalue_adj,digits=3)))

## extract y coords for plots:
y_coords<-coding_mutations_long %>%
      group_by(Effect) %>%
      summarise(y = max(muts, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10)

coding_p_df <- coding_p_df %>%
  left_join(y_coords, by = "Effect")
print(coding_p_df)
```

## c : Figure 2.D: create a plot for comparison of coding mutations :
```{r}
svg('../Figure2/compare_coding_muts.svg',width=6, height=10)

# intiialise plot 
ggplot(coding_mutations_long, aes(x = crypt_colibactin_pos, y = muts)) +
  
  # create boxplot :
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = crypt_colibactin_pos)) +
  
  # facet by effect
  
  facet_wrap(~Effect, scales = "free", ncol = 2,
             
             labeller=labeller(Effect=c(nonsense='Nonsense',
                                       missense='Missense',
                                       indel='Coding Indels',
                                       synonymous='Synonymous'))) +
  
  # add text for pvalues and associated brackets
  geom_text(data = coding_p_df, aes(label = label, y = y, x = 1.5),fontface = "bold")+
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.96*y),color='grey20', inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.945*y),  color='grey20',inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.945*y),  color='grey20',inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  
  # format x and fill scales 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Colibactin\nPositive", "Colibactin\nNegative")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('bisque3','hotpink3')) +
  
  # add labels
  labs(y = "Coding Sequence Mutations per Crypt", x = "Colibactin Mutagenesis Status") +
  
  # format theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face='bold',colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14,colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "inside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
dev.off()
```

## d : cross validate with driver genes :
driver gene list taken from Cornish, A. J. et al. Nature, 2024
```{r}
## read in the list from cornish et al.
driver_genes_list<-read_excel('../Data/CRC_Drivers_Cornish_Nature/41586_2024_7747_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx',sheet=5,skip=7)
driver_genes<-driver_genes_list[1]

## intersect with the dnds annot sum:
drivers_count=nrow(dnds_mut_annotation[dnds_mut_annotation$Gene %in% driver_genes,])
print(paste0('Drivers present : ', drivers_count,' drivers'))
```
